source_text.body:
Update a website automatically
A user says Muse automatically updates their site on their behalf.
·
Sep 27, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
One commenter said they used Muse to build a couple of websites, including an AI news site, in about an hour of back-and-forth conversation. They said the site was set up to automatically update itself by finding rumors about AI releases, checking back later to see whether those rumors were confirmed, and adding related items like interviews; the person then checked the site each morning.
How it went
The reported result was a working site that updated automatically for the user. They did not give traffic, accuracy, or reliability numbers, and framed it as a fun project rather than a proven production workflow.
Worth knowing
The only concrete setup detail was time: they said making the site took about an hour of talking to Muse.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Update my website at [site address] with these changes: [list of updates, e.g. new hours, a new blog post]. Show me exactly what will change before you publish anything. After I approve, make the changes and send me a link to check each updated page.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MetaAI/comments/1wlsli8/what_do_you_think_about_muse
